description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Drive 3 ranks, Evasive Action and Drive-By Attack feats

Benefit: When you use the Drive-By Attack feat, if your attack hits, you can also make an attack against a target adjacent to your original target. You take a -5 penalty on this additional attack, which does not benefit from any effects of a charge.

system.requirements: Drive 3 ranks, Evasive Action and Drive-By Attack feats
